items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Well, I played with some of the Bowling's old men in that band, see? Because Frankie kept the same fellas, but just him and I was different, you see?

ctx.x: Do you want to stop and answer the phone?

No, that'll answer the town set. So, later on, a fella by the name of Frankie Dusen, a trombone player, he started playing with him, see? That's just before Bowling died, see? That's before he went and got sick, in other words. Well, after Bowling left out, then Frankie took the band over. This Dusen was a fella, the trombone player, and he called it the Eagle Band, see? Well, I played with the Eagle Band, with Dusen, because he's from over this side of the river, see? And he knew me as a kid, you know? Well, I…
You played the violin? Yeah, the violin.
